title: A Lean and Spec-Driven AI-Assisted Software Development Lifecycle for Applied AI Education: The AI-SDLC Approach
abstract: arXiv:2609.24348v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI coding agents increasingly support software development beyond code completion, including planning, implementation, testing, and repository-level task execution. Their practical use, however, often remains only weakly connected to established software engineering practices. The aim of this work is to develop and evaluate a lightweight, spec-driven lifecycle for governed agentic software engineering. The lifecycle combines established software engineering practices with repository-local guidance through specifications, AGENTS.md, and phase-specific agent skill files. The approach was developed in the context of the FHNW course AI-assisted Software Development and applied by students to business-oriented software use cases. Its educational and practical applicability is explored through a student survey combining closed rating items with open-ended questions. The contribution of this work is a process-oriented framework that enables AI

translated_title: 一种面向应用型AI教育的精益且规范驱动的AI辅助软件开发生命周期：AI-SDLC方法
translated_abstract: AI编程智能体（AI coding agents）日益超越代码补全的范畴，在软件开发的规划、实现、测试以及仓库级任务执行等方面提供支持。然而，其实际应用往往与既有的软件工程实践联系薄弱。本工作的目标是开发并评估一种轻量级、规范驱动（spec-driven）的生命周期，用于受治理的智能体软件工程。该生命周期将既有的软件工程实践与仓库本地的指导相结合，通过规范文件、AGENTS.md以及针对各阶段的智能体技能文件来实现。该方法是在瑞士西北应用科学与艺术大学（FHNW）的“AI辅助软件开发”课程背景下开发的，并由学生应用于面向业务的软件用例。通过一项结合封闭式评分题与开放式问题的学生调查，探讨了该方法在教育和实践中的适用性。本工作的贡献是一个面向过程的框架，使AI……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种轻量级、规范驱动的AI辅助软件开发生命周期（AI-SDLC），将既有软件工程实践与仓库级规范指导（如AGENTS.md和阶段化智能体技能文件）相结合，并通过学生在应用型AI教育课程中的实际项目验证了其教学与实践适用性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AI-SDLC, a lean and spec-driven AI-assisted software development lifecycle that integrates established software engineering practices with repository-local guidance (specifications, AGENTS.md, and phase-specific agent skill files), and validates its educational and practical applicability through student projects in applied AI education.
